result.summary: The application interface displays a raw string variable as a header instead of a localized human-readable title.

issues.description: The section header 'home_feed.popular_title' is displaying a raw programming key instead of the intended title like 'Popular in Tallinn' or 'Popular restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Update the localization files or the frontend code to correctly fetch and display the translated string for the popular restaurants section title.
